description: PlatformIO packages for embedded development, including libraries, platforms, and tools.

repository.note: The default repository is the PlatformIO Registry at https://registry.platformio.org

namespace_definition.note: The namespace is the owner name of the library in the PlatformIO Registry. It must be lowercased in the canonical form.

name_definition.note: The name is the library identifier in the PlatformIO Registry. It must be lowercased in the canonical form.

version_definition.note: The version is a semantic version string.

qualifiers_definition.description: The target hardware platform (e.g., espressif32, ststm32, atmelavr, teensy).
The target framework (e.g., arduino, espidf, stm32cube, zephyr).
An alternative registry URL for private or self-hosted registries.
